title: Repentance unto Life
definition: Repentance unto Life is a grace-given turning from sin to God with grief over sin and desire for obedience.
summary: Repentance unto Life is the grace-enabled turning from sin to God that accompanies saving faith.
christFocus: Jesus Christ calls sinners to repent and gives mercy to those who come humbly to Him.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
Repentance unto life is the grace-enabled turning from sin to God. Scripture presents repentance not as mere regret, shame, or fear of consequences, but as a change of mind and direction before the Lord.

True repentance sees sin as God sees it and turns toward the mercy offered in Christ. It includes sorrow, but it is not despair because it moves toward life.

Jesus came calling sinners to repent and believe the Gospel. Repentance is not the enemy of grace; it is one of grace's first fruits in a humbled heart.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: This matters because people often confuse repentance with either self-punishment or casual apology. This doctrine shows that repentance is honest, hopeful, and directed toward God through Christ.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Turn from known sin without making excuses, and turn toward Christ without delay. Practice repentance quickly in daily life, and teach it as a gracious doorway to life rather than a hopeless attempt to earn forgiveness.
